Name: Lumisteria-  Alternative Textures - Crops
Author: Lumisteria
Description:
A mod adding texture variations for the crops using Alternative Texture.


What does it changes ?
The main changes are on the harvest-stage of the crop. Some crops have minor changes at other stanges and changes at the seed stage.
It currently changes Ancient Fruit, Bean, Blueberry, Cauliflower, Corn, Cranberry, Eggplant, Fairy Rose, Garlic, Jazz, Parsnip, Poppy, Pumpkin, Rhubarb, Rice, Sunflower, Tulip crops.
All the changes are purely cosmetics.

Consider pairing it with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11317]Messy Crops[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11467]Crop Variation[/url] for an enhanced effect !
